title: Zip and Merge
hints: Two `for range` loops can't advance in step, so turn one (`Zip`) or both (`Merge`) inputs into pull iterators: `next, stop := iter.Pull(seq)` followed immediately by `defer stop()`.

`Zip`: range over `as`; for each `a` call `nextB()`; return if it reports `false` or if `yield(a, b)` returns `false`. `Merge`: read one head from each side (`va, okA := nextA()`), then while both are valid yield the smaller one (`<=` keeps `a` first on ties) and read the next value from **that** side only. Afterwards drain whichever side is left.
